verdict_reason: I independently reduce Rudman et al. Eq. 4.1 to (((sum lambda)^2 / sum(lambda^2)) - 1) / (d - 1); on seven fresh clouds the current _isoscore agrees with a direct covariance-eigendecomposition derivation to 6.66e-16 absolute and with the authors' IsoScore 2.0.1 package to 3.50e-08 absolute. Exact covariance constructions reproduce all nine Table 2 values from 0.000 through 1.000 with maximum absolute error 2.22e-16, and no wrong emitted numeric value was found.
comparable_reason: The raw isoscore is not width-comparable, but the separately named isoscore_effective_dims is. On 65 unique blme_verified_a checkpoints I independently recomputed Spearman rho(d_model) as -0.42795 (p=3.77e-4) for raw versus -0.07470 (p=0.554) for effective dimensions; the normalized correlations with n_layers, vocab_size, and log(parameters) are -0.03094, -0.02947, and -0.13421 (all p>=0.286), while joint log-architecture R^2 falls from 0.3557 to 0.00988. Those checkpoint values use the older common 200-document protocol, so they establish the normalization association rather than current-run provenance.
github_reason: I fetched and inspected the authors' GitHub implementation and executed the repository-linked official PyPI IsoScore 2.0.1 package locally on seven identical float64 arrays, including a 40x128 wide cloud, a rank-1 cloud, anisotropy, translation by 1e4, rotation, and scaling by 1e-8. The maximum absolute BLME/package difference was 3.50e-08 (maximum non-endpoint relative difference 5.92e-07); on rank 1 the package returned +2.91e-08 numerical noise while BLME's paper-consistent [0,1] clip returned exactly 0.
paper_reason: Rudman et al. Table 2 publishes IsoScore(I_9^(k))=(k-1)/8, namely 0.000, 0.125, ..., 1.000. Using paired-axis clouds with exact covariance I_9^(k), the current BLME kernel returned all nine entries with maximum absolute error 2.22e-16 (for example k=5: 0.500000000000000 versus 0.500 published).
confounds_reason: The raw score has a structural ambient-width factor: one fixed 5-dimensional cloud scores 1.000000 at d=5 but 0.001954079 at d=2048, a 511.75x drop, even though zero-padding is an isometry. Across 65 unique checkpoints raw rho is -0.42795 with d_model (p=3.77e-4) and -0.46289 with log(parameters) (p=1.03e-4); isoscore_effective_dims stays 5.000000000000 within 1.87e-14 under the direct padding test and has rho -0.07470/-0.03094/-0.02947/-0.13421 with d_model/n_layers/vocab_size/log(parameters), all p>=0.286, so the association was not moved to another measured architecture variable.
defects: CODE/PROTOCOL: IsoScoreTask.evaluate NaN-gates every N<=d cloud even though Algorithm 1 formally accepts every finite cloud for d>1 except a singleton and official IsoScore 2.0.1 computes the wide case. An exact 10x16 simplex gives 0.533333333333 from _isoscore, 0.533333362447 from the official package, and NaN from the registered task.

CODE/PROTOCOL: geometry_isoscore is absent from core.py's 18 shared-cache candidates. Its effective default is num_samples=1000, but the maximum default among all current cache candidates is 100, so an all-task run silently gives IsoScore at most 100 cached documents; an IsoScore-only run instead takes the uncached path.

CODE/PROTOCOL: cached collection retains up to 512 tokens per document while collect_hidden_states retains exactly 10 when T>10, so the requested task set changes the estimand. A local pythia-70m run on the same two 512-token documents produced cached N=1024 and isoscore=0.018365225 but uncached N=20 and NaN; a controlled N>d fixture moved from 0.000000 uncached to 0.967484 cached.

CODE: _isoscore_null_floor claims to preserve N/d when capping work, but it reduces only N. For requested (N,d)=(83641,768), the executed draw is (52083,768), changing N/d from 108.9076 to 67.8164; an 8-seed d=64 simulation moved the null mean from 0.990664 to 0.985159 (absolute -0.005505).

CONFIG/DOC: resolved defaults are num_samples=1000 and min_points_per_dim=50, but defaults.yaml still says the 50x condition is enforced and NaN-gated while current code merely reports a flag. On the standalone uncached path N is capped at 10,000, so even the narrowest registered d=512 model can reach only 19.531 points/dimension while its numeric score is still emitted.

CODE/DOC: the source calls isoscore_effective_dims an exact duplicate of geometry_svd.participation_ratio, but the latter adds an absolute 1e-12 denominator epsilon. For the same rank-5 cloud scaled by 1e-4, effective dimensions remain 5.000000 while the emitted SVD participation ratio is 0.00998004; at scale 1e-8 it is 1.0e-18, so the claimed computational identity only holds at ordinary activation scale.
